user.title: Set up HVAC Setpoint Curve
user.description: Required: name plus one operating mode. Select only cooling, only heating, both, or sensor-only mode. Sensor-only mode only creates the setpoint and active-state sensors; it will not turn a climate entity on or off.

data.name: Name (required)
data.indoor_temp_sensor: Indoor temperature sensor override (optional; climate current temperature is used automatically)
data.sensor_only: Sensor-only mode: create sensors only, do not control HVAC

preset.title: Starting profiles
preset.description: Choose a separate profile for each configured operating mode. Aggressive cooling is available only for cooling.

data.cooling_on_threshold: Allow a new cooling cycle above averaged outdoor temperature
data.cooling_off_threshold: End cooling curve session below outdoor temperature when no indoor value is available
data.heating_on_threshold: Allow a new heating cycle below averaged outdoor temperature
data.heating_off_threshold: End heating curve session above outdoor temperature when no indoor value is available

control_behavior.title: Thermal inertia and indoor demand
control_behavior.description: The averaged outdoor temperature determines when a new cycle may start. Separate heating and cooling entities can optionally be interlocked so only one can run.

data.indoor_start_delta: Indoor difference from target required to start
data.indoor_stop_delta: Indoor tolerance around target for stabilization
data.indoor_settling_hours: Time indoor temperature must remain stable before ending the curve session
data.opposite_entity_interlock: Switch off the separate opposite HVAC entity when heating or cooling starts

custom_cooling_curve.title: Create custom cooling curve
custom_cooling_curve.description: Enter 3 to 6 points. Each point maps an outdoor temperature to the cooling target temperature.

custom_heating_curve.title: Create custom heating curve
custom_heating_curve.description: Enter 3 to 6 points. Each point maps an outdoor temperature to the heating target temperature.

custom_curve.title: Create custom heating/cooling curve
custom_curve.description: Enter 3 to 6 points. This one curve is used for both heating and cooling.

error.missing_control_or_sensor_only: Choose cooling, heating, or sensor-only mode. Sensor-only creates entities for automations but does not control HVAC.
error.invalid_curve: Curve points must be complete and have unique outdoor temperatures.
error.unsupported_cooling_mode: This climate entity does not support cooling mode.
error.unsupported_heating_mode: This climate entity does not support heating mode.
error.invalid_cooling_hysteresis: Cooling on temperature must be higher than cooling off temperature.
error.invalid_heating_hysteresis: Heating off temperature must be higher than heating on temperature.
error.overlapping_heating_cooling: Heating off temperature must be lower than cooling on temperature.

abort.already_configured: This curve name is already configured.

menu_options.custom_curve: Create or edit custom heating/cooling curve

menu_option_descriptions.linked_entities: Choose climate entities and sensors. Indoor temperature is read automatically from each climate entity unless an override sensor is selected.
menu_option_descriptions.preset: Select a separate built-in profile for each linked operating mode.
menu_option_descriptions.custom_curve: Set one shared 3-6 point curve for both heating and cooling.
menu_option_descriptions.thresholds: Choose when heating and cooling may start based on outdoor temperature.
menu_option_descriptions.control_behavior: Smooth outdoor changes and configure when indoor demand starts and stops a cycle.

linked_entities.title: Linked entities
linked_entities.description: Cooling and heating are independent. Indoor temperature comes automatically from each linked climate entity. Select an indoor sensor only to override that value or for sensor-only mode.

data.indoor_temp_sensor: Indoor temperature sensor override (optional; climate current temperature is used automatically)
data.sensor_only: Sensor-only mode: create sensors only, do not control HVAC

preset.title: Heating and cooling profiles
preset.description: Each profile changes only its own curve. Aggressive cooling is not offered for heating. Use the separate custom-curve editor for custom points.

custom_curve.title: Custom heating/cooling curve
custom_curve.description: Enter 3 to 6 points. This one curve is used for both heating and cooling.

cooling_curve.title: Edit cooling curve
cooling_curve.description: Set 3 to 6 cooling curve points. Each point maps an outdoor temperature to a target temperature.

heating_curve.title: Edit heating curve
heating_curve.description: Set 3 to 6 heating curve points. Each point maps an outdoor temperature to a target temperature.

data.heating_on_threshold: Allow a new heating cycle below averaged outdoor temperature
data.heating_off_threshold: End heating curve session above outdoor temperature when no indoor value is available

control_behavior.title: Thermal inertia and indoor demand
control_behavior.description: A climate mode remains available for its thermostat. Enable the interlock only for two separate entities that must never heat and cool together.
